text: Artscape Weston Common, located east of Weston Road between John Street and King Street, is being developed as a partnership between the City of Toronto, Artscape and Rockport Group to provide an Artscape-managed community cultural hub with indoor and outdoor programming space, 26 affordable housing units for artist-led families and 350 new purpose-built rental homes. Designed to serve multiple needs and interests, Artscape Weston Common, will be an inclusive environment welcoming people of different ages, races, religions, and backgrounds to generate strong positive cultural, economic, social and environmental outcomes. Among many other things, it will also be the new home of the Weston Farmers Market.
